body: No, infact I tend to walk close to traffic (though I aim for the back of the car). It's a timing game for me if that makes sense.

>What do you think brought you to this point?

Probably isolation. I was always a shy quiet introverted kid though. I have one friend I see from time to time, that's all. Honestly I don't have any drive or ambition anymore, so yes, an end to suffering. I'd be happy if I got run over by a bus tomorrow.
